name: CERT Polska Warning List
desc: Phishing and scam domain lookups. Poland-focused; a match does not imply ABC-island targeting.

name: abuse.ch SSLBL
desc: Certificate fingerprints associated with malware infrastructure; private correlation only.

name: CARICERT / Regulatory Authority of Curaçao
desc: Curaçao’s national CERT publishes vulnerability advisories and defensive guidance.

name: Government of Aruba / KPA
desc: Official police and government warnings for Aruba, including SMS and email scams.

name: Dutch Government-Wide Cyber Programme
desc: Digital resilience guidance for Caribbean public institutions, including Bonaire; not a live vulnerability feed.

name: CARICOM IMPACS
desc: Caribbean cyber coordination announcements and regional security context.

name: NCSC Netherlands
desc: Dutch-language patch advisories. Check against your own inventory; not evidence of attacks in the ABC islands.

name: CERT-FR security advisories
desc: French national CERT advisories with affected products and links to fixes.

name: FIRST EPSS
desc: Estimates exploitation probability for patch prioritization. A score is not proof of exploitation.

name: Microsoft Security Response Center
desc: Official Microsoft security updates and affected products.

name: Fortinet PSIRT
desc: Official security advisories and patched versions for Fortinet products.
